details.name: WiseConvert
details.who: All Firefox users who have this add-on installed. Users who wish to continue using this add-on can enable it in the Add-ons Manager.
details.why: This add-on is known to change user settings without their consent, is distributed under multiple add-on IDs, and is also correlated with reports of tab functions being broken in Firefox, in violation of the Add-on Guidelines.
